caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular piece of aged, tan paper with rough, torn edges, on which a colorful, hand-drawn composition is centered. The main feature is a large heart outlined and filled with small red designs, containing the text "William Beuth" in decorative black script. Below the text inside the heart is a faded, illegible word or numbers. Flanking the heart on the lower left and right sides are two birds, each with red-brown bellies, white faces and throats, pale blue-grey wings and tails, and yellow-colored heads and legs, standing on clusters of small blue berries. The heart and birds are surrounded by a border made up of various floral and vine designs in red, green, yellow, and blue, as well as small hearts in red and pink in the corners and at the top. The background of the drawing is a light beige, and there are faded and worn patches of the paper that are darker brown, particularly at the edges on the right and left sides. The entire composition is mounted or displayed on a larger tan sheet.
title: Unframed Birth Certificate
